appearance.extreme: Their brow is a row of gaping heat pits and their eyes have clouded to nothing. They found you in the dark immediately, and they knew where you had been sitting.
appearance.obvious: Two dark pits sit above their eyes, wet and open, and they turn their face toward warm things rather than lit ones.
appearance.subtle: There are two shallow depressions above their eyebrows.

description: Pits have opened above your eyes that read heat instead of light. You can see who is alive through a wall, and which chair somebody just left.
drawbacks: Your actual eyes have got worse
name: Thermal Vision
